# influxdb_variable (Data Source)

Retrieves a dashboard variable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    influxdb = {
      source = "thulasirajkomminar/influxdb"
    }
  }
}

provider "influxdb" {}

data "influxdb_variable" "deployment" {
  id = "0dfa2b8e6d2f0001"
}

output "deployment_variable" {
  value = data.influxdb_variable.deployment
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The variable ID.

### Read-Only

- `arguments` (String) The variable arguments as a JSON object.
- `created_at` (String) Variable creation date in RFC3339 format.
- `description` (String) The variable description.
- `name` (String) The variable name.
- `org_id` (String) The organization ID that owns the variable.
- `updated_at` (String) Last variable update date in RFC3339 format.
